comparison.objective: Operate a handheld 3D scanner to capture a cast housing; candidate mechanically separates media and washers.

comparison.success_condition: ≥95% surface coverage including the top, tracking constraints and 1-second clearance versus ≥98% recovered media, retained washers and 3-second supported release.
